name: crawl-readiness
description: Check whether AI crawlers can read a website, generate llms.txt, robots.txt and JSON-LD, and read LLM Monitor trends.
long_description: Eight tools that call the live Crawl Readiness service. Four audit tools work without an account: score a site 0-100 against 50+ AI crawlers with a prioritized fix list, validate JSON-LD structured data, audit robots.txt line by line, and compare what people see with what AI crawlers receive. A free API key unlocks three generators (llms.txt, an AI-crawler-aware robots.txt, JSON-LD schema) and a read-only view of your LLM Monitor trend: whether ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI mention your brand against competitors over time.

tools.name: check_ai_readiness
tools.description: Score a site 0-100 against 50+ AI crawlers, with a prioritized fix list.

tools.name: validate_schema
tools.description: Audit the JSON-LD structured data on a URL.

tools.name: validate_robots
tools.description: Audit a robots.txt line by line, with AI-crawler coverage.

tools.name: check_content_parity
tools.description: Compare what people see with what AI crawlers receive from a page.

tools.name: generate_llms_txt
tools.description: Crawl a site and produce an llms.txt file (API key).

tools.name: generate_robots_txt
tools.description: Produce an AI-crawler-aware robots.txt, merged into an existing one (API key).

tools.name: generate_schema
tools.description: Produce Organization, WebSite and Article JSON-LD (API key).

tools.name: get_monitor_trend
tools.description: Read your LLM Monitor projects: brand mentions versus competitors across AI providers over time (API key).

crawl_readiness_api_key.title: Crawl Readiness API key
crawl_readiness_api_key.description: Optional. The four audit tools work without it. A free key from https://www.crawlreadiness.com/dashboard unlocks the three generators and the Monitor trend.
